style.backgroundSystem: two fields only, alternating: (a) a real study wall corner, warm apricot matte plaster #EFD9C0 with a pale oak plank floor #DCC3A2 and one curtain edge entering frame left; (b) a flat warm-paper infographic field #F7EEDF carrying saffron #F5BE4F label cards and one large rounded light-grey #EAE7E2 image well. Never a seamless white cyclorama, never a duplicated wall pattern, never a second accent colour
style.direction: sun-warmed paper-and-saffron study storage ecommerce, tidy everyday realism rather than moody designer studio
style.iconSystem: 1.5px single-weight monoline pictograms in #2D2D2D seated inside a white #FFFFFF circle with a soft warm drop shadow, simple geometric shelf / drawer / lock / book marks, maximum four per screen, no filled illustration, no 3D badges, no mixed stroke weights
style.lightingSystem: soft 5600K daylight key entering from camera left across the bay dividers, a warm low bounce from the apricot wall on the shadow side, one raking grazing pass that reads every panel edge and shelf front, honest soft contact shadow under the plinth so the unit never floats; one single light direction reused identically in every frame, no hard long cast shadow, no blown highlights
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: one consistent sun-warmed paper-and-saffron study storage ecommerce visual system across the whole detail-page set; fixed palette of warm paper field #F7EEDF, saffron label cards #F5BE4F, warm honey-oak laminate carcass #D8A96C, flat奶白 door and drawer fronts #F6F5F1, deep charcoal type #2D2D2D, with warm apricot plaster #EFD9C0 and pale oak plank floor #DCC3A2 as the only scene surfaces; warm temperature throughout; one modern geometric sans-serif family, Chinese copy always wrapped in 「」 and always a placeholder, headline 30-42pt, labels 11-14pt, under 50 characters per screen; background system alternates only the real study wall corner and the flat warm-paper infographic field with saffron label cards and one large rounded light-grey #EAE7E2 image well, each screen keeping one clean text zone; lighting system of a soft 5600K daylight key from camera left with a warm low bounce off the apricot wall, one raking grazing pass along panel edges and shelf fronts, honest soft contact shadow under the plinth, single light direction in every frame, never a flat shadowless studio and never one hard long cast shadow; surface system that renders the supplied laminate faces, edge lamination lines, metal bar pulls and small round cylinder locks exactly as supplied, matte, never repainted or glossed; layout system of thin 1px leader lines, small numbered dots and 1.5px monoline pictograms in #2D2D2D inside white #FFFFFF circles, at most four icons per screen; product presentation keeps the identical staggered bay rhythm, divider offsets, shelf-row count, drawer count and door-leaf split in every frame, corrected straight verticals, unit grounded on its plinth with contact shadow, a real furnishing as scale anchor, props never hiding joints or hardware; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no changed bay or drawer layout, no invented timber species, board grade, eco claim, load rating, dimensions or certificates, no brand marks or QR codes.
noDrift: no random backgrounds or studio cyclorama
no inconsistent lighting direction or contradictory shadows
no changed bay layout, divider offsets, shelf-row count, drawer count, handle profile or door-leaf split
no invented timber species, board grade, E0 or ENF claim, load rating, dimension figure, warranty year or certificate

style.presentationRules: the unit keeps the exact staggered bay rhythm, divider offsets, shelf-row count, drawer count and door-leaf split from the reference in every frame; front facade kept parallel to the sensor with corrected verticals; always standing on the floor on its own plinth with visible contact shadow; a real furnishing (desk chair, floor lamp or sofa arm) anchors scale in every scene frame; books and objects sit inside the bays without hiding divider joints, handle profiles or lock positions
style.surfaceSystem: warm honey-oak laminate faces #D8A96C with a thin edge lamination line visible at every cut edge, flat奶白 door and drawer fronts #F6F5F1, slim metal bar pulls and small round cylinder locks rendered as supplied and never redrawn, pale oak plank floor #DCC3A2 as the shared ground plane
style.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif family throughout; Chinese in-image copy always wrapped in 「」 and always a placeholder, never the source wording; headline 30-42pt, subtitle 16-20pt, label 11-14pt, no more than 50 characters rendered per screen, no dense body copy, thin 1px leader lines and small numbered dots as the only ornament
